description: This is a Java interface defining service operations related to CustomerOptionValue entities in a shop management system. It extends a generic service and provides methods to list, save/update, and retrieve options by code for customer options.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueService
classes.description: An interface extending a generic service to manage CustomerOptionValue entities, providing methods for listing by store and language, saving or updating, and retrieving by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects for a specified merchant store and language, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a CustomerOptionValue entity.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionValue entity based on the store and a specific option value code.
